name: hunt_pb_vwaptouch_day40

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (angle: pullbacks in the day trend): in New York, the first return to the whole day's VWAP (from 00:00 ET, overnight volume included) after price has run 40 points away from it, bought (sold) with a limit AT that VWAP on the side price came from; 35-point stop, 1:1.5. Why it should pay: the day's VWAP is the average price of everyone positioned since midnight; when New York has carried price 40 points beyond it, the first pullback to it is where the overnight-and-morning side adds again. The day's side against a since-midnight anchor is the one gate that recurs among this repo's leads (the noise band and the vault break use the VWAP from 01:00). Who loses: the traders who fade the day's move at its average price and are run over when it holds.

entry.words: VWAP from 00:00 ET of the trade date (1-minute typical prices). A 1-minute close at least 40 points (160 ticks) above it arms a LONG; 40 points below arms a SHORT. At each 5-minute close inside New York (09:30-15:58), with an arm set and flat, rest a limit AT that VWAP (re-priced every 5-minute close) to buy (long arm) or sell (short arm). Only the FIRST touch counts: a minute whose range comes within 3 ticks of the VWAP uses the arm up, filled or not; a new 40-point excursion arms again. Stop 35 points, target 52.5 points. One trade a session pass, flat 15:58.

not_run: THE VWAP: the family's own, volume-weighted (h + l + c) / 3 of the 1-minute bars from 00:00 ET of the trade date (the evening before is not in it); not the 01:00 anchor of the noise band (an hour apart: the family has no 01:00 anchor).
THE ARM can be set before 09:30 by an overnight 1-minute close; a touch before 09:30 uses it up. Orders are placed only at 5-minute closes inside the New York passes.
THE ORDER: placed and re-priced only at 5-minute closes, only while the last print is on the passive side; a fill needs a one-tick trade-through (strict_limit).
CAPPED PER SESSION PASS, NOT PER DAY: nyam, mid and pm are three passes, so a day can hold up to 3 trades and a trade of one pass may still be open when another pass enters.
Shares its trigger with hunt_pb_vwaptouch_us40 (another line): some touches are the same price on the same minute when the two VWAPs sit together.
The random control draws its entries on any bar of the pass, matched by day; it does not wait for an armed touch.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage on market and stop fills, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only; the 3:1 block walk-forward comes later under PREREG.
